title: VoterTrack System Log: Unauthorized Voter Record Edits

lines.msg: User 'nruiz@lislevotes.example' (Nina Ruiz, VR Clerk) initiated batch update: 1,186 records in 'Absentee Ballot Status' field for Precincts 111 and 112.
All 1,186 records updated to 'received' status. No MFA prompt logged.
Source IP 10.100.45.12 (not in authorized 10.72.x.x range) confirmed as external.
No associated login event for user 'nruiz@lislevotes.example' from 02:00 to 02:50.
User not present in physical access log for Level 1, Room 210, 02:00–02:50.
System integrity check failed: 1,186 records modified in 35 seconds. Average rate: 33.9 edits/sec.
Forwarding rule created in user inbox: 'Move all messages to folder: 'Reports/Exfiltrated' and send to external address: r.oz@outlook.com'.
Unauthorized edit to Pollbook 64: 'Mark as valid for in-person voting' enabled for 1,186 voters.
Audit trail altered: deletion of 24 prior edit events from 'nruiz@lislevotes.example' logged at 02:04.
System health: SQL database (LCBOE-SQL01) at 98% load. Memory spike detected.
Network egress to IP 104.213.142.77 (port 443) detected at 02:05:21.
User session terminated abruptly. No logout event.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the attack vector: compromised credentials and unauthorized mass edits. Watch for IT to isolate LCBOE-VR01 and LCBOE-SQL01, disable the account, and notify the CISO and Director.
